author: Praxis I
title: Dual-BRBG-Adapt-PCA72: ComBat PCA72 + Adaptive Residualized Graph (k=48)
abstract: Dual BRBG with larger ComBat embedding (72 PCs) and adaptive per-PC residualization on graph PCs (γ_j=min(0.74, 0.9·R²_j)), equal-quota balanced kNN (k=48, cosine, binary). Tests whether PCA72 boosts ARI/NMI without hurting mixing.
